title: Big catalogue — live storefront test
summary: Live test of the storefront with the big development catalogue (about 5,000 products, 30,000 offers and 60 sellers per country). 16 markets ran: home, Electronics category, a product with several sellers and search. Average page load (domcontentloaded → main): home 1121 ms, category 2329 ms, product 1194 ms, search 1331 ms. API one request at a time (warm): category listing avg 167 ms, facets avg 221 ms, facets with colour + FBN + arrives-by filters avg 309 ms (max 344 ms), search avg 137 ms. Mega menu: 256 of 256 flyouts opened, average open 251 ms.
environment: Storefront http://localhost:3000 (npm run build && next start)
API and panels http://localhost:8000 (php artisan serve, 8 workers)
